title: Looking for a Laptop (under $1500) for a High School Student
body:
My high school kid has “ [Refurb] HP EliteBook x360 830 G6: 13.3" FHD Touch, i5-8265U, 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD $351.20 ($342.42 eBay Plus) Shipped @ HT eBay” bought in OZB deal 3yrs ago. Its started giving issues now eg battery doesn’t last longer than 2hrs, cracked screen etc.
So back in market with Budget: $1500
Minimum I’d target:
16 GB RAM + 256 GB SSD + modern Core 5/Core Ultra 5 or Ryzen 5/7 + 14–15” IPS display.
Battery life is priority.
Touchscreen (preferred but not must have)
Please recommend some good options. Thanks.
